_about: Local support directory for DropWise YYC, written in the Open Referral Human Services Data Specification (HSDS) shape: organizations → services → phones. Check numbers before launch.

services.name: 24-hour crisis support
services.description: Free, confidential emotional support by phone, text or chat for anyone feeling overwhelmed.

services.name: Suicide Crisis Helpline
services.description: Canada-wide crisis line. Call or text.

services.name: Health Link (nurse advice)
services.description: Talk to a registered nurse about health questions, e.g. dehydration or hygiene worries.

services.name: Community & social services finder
services.description: Connects you to food, housing, seniors' and newcomer services across Alberta.

services.name: City services & water restrictions
services.description: Report water leaks or main breaks and ask about Stage 4 rules.
